title: 核心词汇辨析专项
passage: 核心词汇辨析专项训练：选择最合适的词填入句子中。

questions.question_text: The scientist made a ____ discovery that changed the course of medicine.
questions.analysis: groundbreaking 意为"开创性的、突破性的"，修饰 discovery 表示突破性发现。grounded 意为"有根据的"，groundless 意为"无根据的"，groundwork 是名词"基础"。

questions.question_text: She has a ____ ability to understand complex mathematical concepts quickly.
questions.analysis: 需要形容词修饰名词 ability，natural ability 表示"天生的能力"。nature 是名词，naturally 是副词，naturalize 是动词。

questions.question_text: The company decided to ____ its operations to Southeast Asia.
questions.analysis: expand 意为"扩张、扩大"，expand operations 表示扩大业务范围。expend 是"花费"，extend 是"延伸（时间或空间）"，extent 是名词"程度"。

questions.question_text: His argument was so ____ that even his critics had to agree.
questions.analysis: compelling 意为"有说服力的、令人信服的"，修饰 argument 表示有说服力的论点。competing 是"竞争的"，compiling 是"编译的"，complaining 是"抱怨的"。

questions.question_text: The two words are similar in meaning but have subtle ____ in usage.
questions.analysis: distinction 意为"区别、差别"，subtle distinctions 表示细微的差别。extinction 是"灭绝"，instinct 是"本能"，distraction 是"分心"。
